title: 추천 시스템 - 협업 필터링
code:
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity
import numpy as np

user_matrix = np.array([[5, 4, 0], [3, 0, 4], [0, 5, 3]])
similarity = cosine_similarity(user_matrix)
print(similarity)

title: 추천 시스템 - 컨텐츠 기반
code:
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

courses = ['Python', 'JavaScript', 'Python Advanced']
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer()
matrix = vectorizer.fit_transform(courses)
similarity = cosine_similarity(matrix)

title: 머신러닝 - 선형 회귀
code:
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
import numpy as np

X = np.array([[1], [2], [3], [4]])
y = np.array([2, 4, 5, 4])
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)
print(model.predict([[5]]))

title: 분류 - K-means
code:
from sklearn.cluster import KMeans
import numpy as np

data = np.array([[0, 0], [1, 1], [5, 5], [6, 6]])
kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=2)
kmeans.fit(data)
print(kmeans.labels_)

title: 이미지 분류
code:

from tensorflow.keras.applications.mobilenet import MobileNet

model = MobileNet(weights='imagenet')

x = image.img_to_array(img)
result = model.predict(x)

title: 학습 곡선
code:
from sklearn.model_selection import learning_curve
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

train_sizes, train_scores, val_scores = learning_curve(DecisionTreeClassifier(), X, y, cv=5)
print(f'Train: {train_scores.mean()}, Val: {val_scores.mean()}')

title: 하이퍼파라미터 튜닝
code:
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV
from sklearn.svm import SVC

param_grid = {'C': [0.1, 1, 10], 'kernel': ['linear', 'rbf']}
grid = GridSearchCV(SVC(), param_grid, cv=5)
grid.fit(X, y)
print(grid.best_params_)
